name: YouTube Data API
limitations: Search and channel-upload metadata; no unauthorized caption or media downloading.
next_step: Configure an API key and explicit query/page budgets; approve retention policy.

name: CNN program transcripts
limitations: Program/date text can locate appearances; pages are not media-download licenses.
next_step: Obtain permitted exports; capture a real schema fixture before a dedicated adapter.

name: CBS program transcripts
limitations: Official program text; access and HTML format may vary.
next_step: Use permitted transcript export and the manual input contract.

name: Internet Archive
limitations: Metadata and file inventory, not a guarantee of downloadable TV recordings.
next_step: Inspect item-level availability and rights before selecting files.

name: GDELT Television Explorer
limitations: Coverage and time ranges vary by interface; captions can contain errors.
next_step: Capture current endpoint/response contract; do not assume archive completeness.

name: GDELT Visual Explorer
limitations: Visual/on-screen-text leads are distinct from spoken statements.
next_step: Locate current Visual Explorer documentation and a permitted export; the previously proposed deep-link could not be verified.

name: GDELT Television Ngrams
limitations: Aggregated phrase counts cannot reconstruct statements or establish speakers.
next_step: Obtain documented sample files and implement a frequency-only adapter.

name: GDELT Global Quotation Graph
limitations: Nested quotations with context; no automatic speaker confirmation.
next_step: Download an authorized dated .gqg.json.gz file, retain checksum, then ingest.

name: Quotebank
limitations: Historical 2008–2020 quotations; probabilistic speaker labels remain leads.
next_step: Review dataset rights and choose quotation-centric JSONL .bz2.

name: Media Cloud
limitations: Article metadata/discovery is not a full-text export license.
next_step: Obtain credentials and a current first-party client response fixture.

name: LexisNexis / Nexis Uni
limitations: Interactive research access does not imply bulk API rights.
next_step: Negotiate transcript exports or a feed; supply actual schema samples.

name: TVEyes
limitations: Advertises APIs and data feeds; endpoint and reuse contract needed.
next_step: Request evaluation transcript/audio package and written retention/derivation rights.

name: Critical Mention
limitations: Advertises JSON HTTP API; partner contract remains necessary.
next_step: Request credentials, pagination contract, historical backfill limits, sample records.

name: Sprinklr
limitations: Coverage documentation alone does not establish API/export scope.
next_step: Verify purchased package exports and exact permitted content fields.

name: SnapStream
limitations: Operator-controlled capture/export; feed rights remain separate.
next_step: Obtain authorized recording export plus captions and program metadata.

name: Grabien
limitations: Clip discovery; no public bulk API contract verified here.
next_step: Request permitted exports or partnership access; link clips to original events.

name: American Archive of Public Broadcasting
limitations: Public metadata; transcript API needs research credentials; schema is experimental.
next_step: Use metadata client; request transcript credentials and capture actual samples.

name: C-SPAN Video Library
limitations: Program/clip leads; user clip titles are not verified event descriptions.
next_step: Obtain permitted source records; confirm original program and time alignment.

name: Vanderbilt Television News Archive
limitations: Research/loan access; not a general footage redistribution license.
next_step: Arrange permitted research access and record restrictions per item.

name: Google Fact Check Tools API
limitations: Paginated claim search; no guaranteed enumerate-all dump.
next_step: Configure key; use claim/publisher queries and preserve pagination.

name: ClaimReview structured data
limitations: A vocabulary, not an independent publisher or truth source.
next_step: Import authorized JSON/JSON-LD while retaining the actual publishing organization.

name: Fact-Check Insights
limitations: Bulk claim/review metadata; raw ratings remain publisher-attributed.
next_step: Obtain authorized JSON export; clarify compilation/media/commercial permissions.

name: MediaVault / MediaReview
limitations: Archived media/reviews have separate permission questions.
next_step: Request access and sample MediaReview records; preserve source-media chain.

name: PolitiFact
limitations: Selected investigations, not a representative sample of everything said.
next_step: Use permitted ClaimReview or manual exports; preserve external review identity.

name: PunditFact
limitations: A PolitiFact collection; do not double-count a review discovered through both.
next_step: Link to canonical publisher review; trace its source broadcast.

name: FactCheck.org
limitations: Published investigations and their sources; selected coverage.
next_step: Import permitted article references and primary-evidence links.

name: Reuters Fact Check
limitations: External investigation with its own scope, date, and revision history.
next_step: Retain attributed review; independently match the actual claim scope.

name: AFP Fact Check
limitations: Includes manipulated-media investigations; keep media and claim reviews distinct.
next_step: Preserve source references, language, translation, and assessed-media identity.

name: Media Matters for America
limitations: Editorially selected leads; cannot define the full monitored denominator.
next_step: Verify original context and maintain independent source coverage inventory.

name: Media Research Center
limitations: Editorially selected leads; no outlet reputation used as evidence of a claim.
next_step: Trace underlying source material and preserve selection origin.

name: NewsBusters
limitations: Related MRC collection; overlapping records require provenance deduplication.
next_step: Treat excerpts as leads, not automatically accepted speaker statements.

name: NewsGuard False Claim Fingerprints
limitations: Machine-readable commercial research; not an automatic first-party finding.
next_step: Negotiate feed; preserve provider fields without normalizing outlet/person scores.

name: Full Fact AI
limitations: Licensed monitoring/claim matching tools; no public bulk corpus established.
next_step: Evaluate software integration or partnership separately from a data license.

name: Authorized manual input
limitations: For user-owned or explicitly permitted metadata, transcripts, and primary documents.
next_step: Supply an explicit rights grant and the documented manual JSON envelope.

name: Internet Archive TV News Archive
limitations: Closed-caption search and short previews locate broadcast segments; captions contain recognition errors and full-program access or reuse is restricted.
next_step: Capture a bounded caption-search sample and record which program, date and preview fields are actually returned.

name: Subject-operated social media accounts
limitations: Posts from accounts the subject verifiably operates; each platform has separate API, retention and deletion terms. The subject's own video channel is collected through the youtube source.
next_step: Establish reviewed account ownership for each platform, then obtain a permitted export or API grant; use the manual envelope until then.

name: Subject-authored columns, op-eds and newsletters
limitations: Bylined writing is first-party text but may be edited by a publisher; headlines and pull quotes are usually not written by the author.
next_step: Inventory bylines through permitted publisher pages or feeds; retain the publication version and any correction notice.

name: Podcast feeds and radio programs
limitations: Feeds list episodes and guests but rarely transcripts; a public audio enclosure is not permission to retain, transcribe or clip it.
next_step: Build a bounded inventory of relevant show feeds and record per-show terms before any audio acquisition.

name: Congress.gov API
limitations: Legislative records (bills, actions, votes, members); text versions and action histories change as bills advance.
next_step: Request an API key; capture a bounded sample for one bill and record the retrieved version and action date.

name: GovInfo API
limitations: Official published documents (Congressional Record, statutes, hearings, budget documents); publication dates can lag events.
next_step: Request an API key; capture a bounded document package and retain its package identifier and granule locator.

name: Federal Register API
limitations: Rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents; a proposed rule is not a final rule.
next_step: Capture a bounded document sample and record document type, docket and effective date.

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API
limitations: Official labor and price statistics; figures are revised and seasonally adjusted and unadjusted series differ.
next_step: Capture a bounded series sample and record series ID, adjustment, period and release vintage.

name: U.S. Census Bureau Data API
limitations: Official demographic and economic data; survey estimates carry margins of error and geography definitions change over time.
next_step: Capture a bounded table sample and record dataset, vintage, geography and margin of error.

name: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) API
limitations: Aggregates series from originating agencies; cite the originating agency and the data vintage, not FRED alone.
next_step: Request an API key; capture a bounded series sample with its originating source and vintage dates.

name: OpenFEC API
limitations: Campaign-finance filings; amended filings supersede earlier ones and processed data can lag raw filings.
next_step: Request an API key; capture a bounded committee sample and record filing and amendment identifiers.

name: CourtListener API
limitations: Court opinions, dockets and oral-argument audio; docket coverage is incomplete and a filing is not a ruling.
next_step: Request an API token; capture a bounded docket and opinion sample and record court, docket number and document type.

name: Other official agency, legislative and court publications
limitations: Catch-all for official reports, budget scores, audits, state and local records and press releases without a dedicated connector; a press release is an official claim, not independent verification.
next_step: Import through the manual envelope with the actual publishing body as source; add a dedicated entry once a source recurs.
